sources.title: Cyber Lasso
sources.role: Mechanic reference for arrow-key movement, a trailing tile-occupying rope, and a space-triggered lasso interaction that can snag objects.

transformation: An original, self-contained loading-yard bridge. A walking tug leaves a finite visible tile path; the independent transition model recognizes an orthogonal loop and advances the first unsatisfied crate toward its marked pad. The yard, crate identities, artwork, controls, generator, grader, verifier and solver are newly implemented.
license_note: The cited game supplies mechanic inspiration only. No source code, artwork, audio, branding or puzzle data is bundled.
